customManagers.description: Versions passed as Dockerfile ARGs (e.g. the Coraza plugin compiled into the WAF image) that no built-in manager reads. Mark them with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` on the line above the ARG.
Tool versions pinned in workflow env blocks (e.g. TRIVY_VERSION), marked with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` on the line above.
Update the zizmor image tag and digest together in validate-workflows.yaml
matchStrings: # zizmor-image: tracked by the dedicated regex manager in \.github/renovate\.json\s+ZIZMOR_IMAGE: "ghcr\.io/zizmorcore/zizmor:(?<currentValue>[^@"]+)@(?<currentDigest>sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})"

packageRules.description: Flux owns these mutable-tag digest pins.
This setup manages image tags and Helm charts, not Kubernetes API migrations.
Require dashboard checkbox approval for all major updates to prevent breaking changes.

Hold the Gateway API CRDs at the version Cilium is built and conformance-tested against (Cilium 1.20 = v1.6.3: sigs.k8s.io/gateway-api in its go.mod, gateway_api_version in Documentation/conf.py). Raise this bound when the Cilium release in use moves to v1.7. Note: v1.7.0's safe-upgrades policy rejects CRDs older than v1.7.0, so that upgrade cannot simply be rolled back.
Group general patch updates together (Gateway API stays separate: its PR needs a manual CRD bundle swap and must not block the group's automerge)
Automerge digest-only and patch updates once their CI checks pass (Flux then rolls them out). Minor and major updates stay manual.

Never automerge Gateway API bumps: the update only changes the version comment in gateway-api/kustomization.yaml, while the vendored standard-install.yaml (in ignorePaths) has to be replaced by hand from the matching release in the same PR.
abuseipdb-sync: the build workflow requires a new IMAGE_REVISION whenever the image source changes, so bump it in every Renovate update to that source (e.g. golang, Go modules).
taskflow-caddy-coraza: the build workflow requires a new IMAGE_REVISION whenever the Dockerfile changes, so bump it in every Renovate update to it (caddy, docker/dockerfile).

Own image abuseipdb-sync (tags <app>-r<revision>): docker versioning treats -rN as an incompatible suffix and never moves the pin, so order by app version then revision. Built and tested by CI, so no release-age wait.
Own image taskflow-caddy-coraza (tags <caddy>-coraza<coraza>-r<revision>, revision never resets): order by Caddy version then revision. Built and tested by CI, so no release-age wait.
Group Metrics Server chart and controller image together
Helm charts: HTTP HelmRepository (helm) and OCIRepository (docker) sources.
flux2 and kubectl in mise.toml follow the cluster's Flux and k3s minors (scripts/check-tool-versions.sh); only patch updates are automatic.

Pin every GitHub Action to a commit digest with a '# vX.Y.Z' comment: a tag can be moved to other code (76 of 77 aquasecurity/trivy-action tags were force-pushed to malicious commits in March 2026). zizmor's unpinned-uses audit (validate-workflows.yaml) fails on a tag ref.
